rule: protected read requires a token
protected cart read requires a token
writes must require authentication
deletes must require authentication
a user can read their own record
a user must not read another user's record
a user can update their own record
a user must not modify another user's record
a user must not delete another user's record
a user can read their own carts
a user must not read another user's carts
a user must not escalate their own role
an admin can read any user
an admin can update any user
an admin can delete any user (simulated by the sandbox)
an admin can read any user's carts
protected write requires a token
protected delete requires a token
account creation must require authentication (anyone can create an admin)
a user's carts must not be readable without authentication
identity fields such as id must be immutable
a user must not take another user's username
